name: Cusack Music

name: British Pedal Company / early JMI team
notes: British Pedal Company says its team developed/designed/recreated pedals for JMI in the early 2000s, separated from JMI in 2011 and launched its own brand in 2014. Exact early JMI catalog requires deeper archival work.
